overview: Following nationwide midterm results, Democrats have flipped control of Congress, sending stock markets higher as investors anticipate political gridlock. In commercial real estate news, an energy management platform announced the return of its co-founder as CEO to lead a new storage battery business. Locally in San Francisco, political races point to shifting council dynamics alongside cultural celebrations like the Valkyries victory parade. Meanwhile, in Hawaii, election results show significant political updates including mayoral victories in Maui and Kauai alongside gubernatorial success for Gov. Josh Green.

items.title: Stocks Rise as Democrats Flip Control of Congress
items.summary: Stock markets traded higher as investors anticipated gridlock in Washington after Democrats flipped control of Congress.

items.title: GridPoint Co-Founder Adrian De Luca Returns as CEO to Power New Battery Product
items.summary: GridPoint announced that co-founder Adrian De Luca has returned as CEO to lead the rollout of its new storage battery business.

items.title: How Scott Wiener built a lead over Connie Chan she’s unlikely to reverse
items.summary: Scott Wiener built a lead over Connie Chan by securing support in neighborhoods that traditionally vote for progressives.

items.title: Gov. Josh Green secures 2nd term in Hawaii’s largest gubernatorial victory ever
items.summary: Gov. Josh Green won a resounding reelection victory alongside running mate and outgoing Kauai Mayor Derek Kawakami.

items.title: Bissen, Rapozo winners in Maui and Kauai mayoral races
items.summary: Maui County Mayor Richard Bissen and Kauai winner Rapozo secured mayoral victories in Tuesday's election.

wiki.title: Eunos MRT station
wiki.extract: Eunos MRT station is an elevated Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station on the East–West Line in Geylang, Singapore. Operated by SMRT Trains, the station is connected to the Eunos Bus Interchange. It also provides access to other surrounding landmarks such as the Masjid Darul Aman, Eunos Crescent Market and Food Centre, and Mangala Vihara Buddhist Temple.
